name: DO-178C Airborne Systems Software Certification
description: Compliance framework for FAA / EASA DO-178C (Software Considerations in Airborne Systems and Equipment Certification) across Software Levels A, B, C, D, and E, covering PSAC, SAS, SVR, structural coverage analysis (MC/DC), and DER audit evidence.

checklists.name: DO-178C Airborne Software Certification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DO-178C Tables A-1 to A-10 objectives.

items.statement: Plan for Software Aspects of Certification (PSAC) is approved by the FAA / EASA Designated Engineering Representative (DER).
High-level software requirements (HLR) and low-level software requirements (LLR) maintain bi-directional traceability (Table A-3).
Source code complies with Software Coding Standards and eliminates unexecutable or dead code (Table A-5).
Modified Condition / Decision Coverage (MC/DC) achieves 100% coverage for Level A flight control software (Table A-7).
Software Accomplishment Summary (SAS) and Software Configuration Index (SCI) are submitted for final DER sign-off.

reviewGates.name: DO-178C Designated Engineering Representative (DER) Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Designated Engineering Representative (DER) / Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE) attests that DO-178C life cycle objectives are satisfied.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the avionics software verification package confirm 100% objective completion under DO-178C?
